title: Story bed: tension
description: A celli ostinato doubled an octave up by violas, a ticking woodblock and low piano octaves; the pulse, violas tremolo and the motif's tail (vibes, violins) from bar 8; high violins, tom rolls and a swell from bar 16.
usage: The motif version: for intros, outros and gaps between lines. Under speech prefer the -underscore version. Loops seamlessly. -26 LUFS-S with a voice pocket at 1.25-2 kHz for the narration; duck it with scripts/audio/duck.py (the band-split duck, its default). All four story beds share 75 BPM, so they can be switched on a bar line (every 3.2 s).
instruments: VSCO 2 celli and violas (fast), basses, violas tremolo, violins
VCSL woodblock, toms, bass drum, cymbal swell
selfReview: A celli ostinato with phrygian Eb neighbours, a woodblock clock and the motif's fragments on vibes and violins. Critic round 1 (2026-11-24): for phone presence violas (VSCO 2, fast bowing) double the ostinato an octave up, the woodblock is softer, and the motif left the low piano and celli. Phone loss 6.6-6.7 LU (7.9 before; Zoo 5.4). The trade-off: the upper layer adds 1-4 kHz onsets, so its index under Zoo with the band-split duck is 0.79 (0.83 for the first build with the same duck), still above the 0.75 gate and speech-shaped noise (0.69). The -underscore version mutes the motif and lead lines; use it under speech.
